## NewsForge v26.4.12

This stable release rolls up the recent `26.4.11` beta-line reader extraction fixes into a formal version.

### Fixes
- Filtered WSJ top author headshots and byline timestamp blocks out of article extraction
- Filtered WSJ series-navigation modules out of article text
- Broadened FT filtering for teaser, event-promo, and `Latest on ...` modules
- Filtered NYTimes Opinion footer and letters-style promo blocks more reliably
- Filtered Economist print-edition, newsletter, and daily-quiz promo modules out of article extraction

### Package
- Chrome extension package: `newsforge-v26.4.12.zip`
